occurred: The state-dispatch observer reached 0x1400494e0 but its combined CDB command failed with a syntax error before continuing; command included db @rbp+0x10d L0x13, stack, and disassembly commands.
observed_effect: Observer exited with code 2147942430. target_native_return, caller diff, and RC06-after were not observed. The sample itself later exited 0x0/EXIT_DECODE and all sample/component identity and harvest hashes matched.
why: The observer command was edited as a compound string without first running the exact generated command through the installed CDB in a harmless validation path. The process optimized for collecting many fields at one breakpoint instead of preserving the minimum continuation command.
minimum_fix: Use a new run and a one-shot breakpoint at statically proven 0x14004c2e1. The callback must contain only syntax-validated echo/register/dd/bc/g commands; remove db, k, and u from the critical continuation path.
rollback: Discard the new observer copy and retain the C335 runner and evidence unchanged.
success: The observer reaches 0x14004c2e1, records the selector and return context, continues without CDB error, and leaves target seam fields to the existing runtime observer.
